# AstryxTabList { #anylumino.AstryxTabList }

```python
AstryxTabList(items, value, **props)
```

Render an Astryx tab list.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Default    |
|---------|-----------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| items   | Iterable\[Any\] | Item records used by generated child components or static search sources.                                                                                                                                                                                     | _required_ |
| value   | str             | Synchronized component value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | _required_ |
| **props | Any             | JSON-safe TabList props. Useful keys: size, layout, hasDivider, orientation, className, and style. anylumino generates tabs from items and manages value/onChange synchronization. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/TabList>. | `{}`       |
